status: Analytical design scenario; not measured corpus ingestion or task performance
source: User requested a catalog exceeding 50 million parts. Counts and token densities below are explicit design assumptions, not vendor statistics.
scope: Text only; excludes images, CAD geometry, simulation data, indexes, metadata overhead and duplicate elimination. Manuals are a separate corpus in this scenario.
normalization: corpus_tokens / window_tokens; log10 ratio is orders of magnitude. A window equivalent is not a model call or a cost estimate.
uncertainty: Sensitivity values are assumptions, not confidence intervals. No sampled observations.
